messages.content: "請問你能告訴我是誰發現了希格斯玻色子，並提供有關他們的額外細節，如他們的出生日期和國籍嗎？此外，我是一個180磅，身高5'11"的中等活躍的人，你能預測我患上2型糖尿病的可能性嗎？最後，我計劃去巴黎的羅浮宮博物館，你能告訴我星期一的開放時間嗎？"

function.name: get_discoverer
function.description: Get the person or team who made a particular scientific discovery Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

discovery.description: The discovery for which the discoverer's information is needed.

detail.description: Optional flag to get additional details about the discoverer, such as birth date and nationality. Defaults to false.

function.name: museum_working_hours_get
function.description: Get the working hours of a museum in a specific location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

day.description: Specific day of the week. Optional parameter. Default is 'Monday'.

function.name: diabetes_prediction
function.description: Predict the likelihood of diabetes type 2 based on a person's weight and height. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

weight.description: Weight of the person in lbs.

height.description: Height of the person in inches.

activity_level.description: Physical activity level of the person.

message.reasoning:
The user asks three things:

1. Who discovered the Higgs boson? Provide extra details like birth date and nationality. They want the discoverer(s). The Higgs boson was predicted by Peter Higgs and others in 1964. It was discovered at CERN in 2012. The discoverer is Peter Higgs (theoretical physicist) and also François Englert. But the question: "who discovered the Higgs boson?" The discoverer is the experimental team at CERN, but the theoretical prediction was by Peter Higgs. The user wants the discoverer(s) and extra details. We can use the get_discoverer function. Provide discovery: "Higgs boson". detail: true.

2. Predict the likelihood of diabetes type 2 based on weight 180 lbs, height 5'11" (71 inches), activity level "moderately active" or "lightly active"? The user says "中等活躍的人" which means moderately active. So activity_level: "moderately active".

We call diabetes_prediction with weight=180, height=71, activity_level="moderately active".

3. Working hours of Louvre Museum in Paris on Monday. Use museum_working_hours_get with museum="Louvre Museum", location="Paris", day="Monday".

We need to call all three functions. The order: first get_discoverer, then diabetes_prediction, then museum_working_hours_get. We'll produce separate calls.
